# Mochizuki original-paper context for the different/conductor route

Author: Shinichi Mochizuki. Title: *Arithmetic Elliptic Curves in General Position*. PDF title-page date: **February 2009**.

Official PDF: https://www.kurims.kyoto-u.ac.jp/~motizuki/Arithmetic%20Elliptic%20Curves%20in%20General%20Position.pdf

Local PDF: `/home/admin-wsl/Coq/abc/refer/Mochizuki/Arithmetic Elliptic Curves in General Position.pdf`

SHA-256: `b9dc115af61dca7fe434332ebafddf6a376a9e2926dad4e1ea2dcc0d2441f768`

HTTP HEAD 200; application/pdf; Content-Length 262332; 2026-11-14. Existing local PDF used; not downloaded.

Printed page numbers coincide with 1-based PDF page numbers.

Ghostscript txtwrite, followed by visual checking of the rasterized PDF pages. Line wrapping and typographic ligatures normalized; mathematical typography transcribed as LaTeX. Words and mathematical relation signs preserved.

**Version warning:** The existing Markdown transcription is not this PDF version: it says March 2008, while the actual PDF title page says February 2009; its Theorem 2.1 proof also differs. Do not use it as an exact-quotation source.

## Mochizuki-GenEll-Prop1.7i

Proposition 1.7(i), statement; printed/PDF pages: [9, 10].

(i) If we restrict functions on $Z(\overline{\mathbb{Q}})$, $U_Z(\overline{\mathbb{Q}})$ to $U_Y(\overline{\mathbb{Q}})$ via $\phi$, then
\[
\mathrm{log\text{-}cond}_E-\mathrm{log\text{-}cond}_D\lesssim\mathrm{log\text{-}diff}_Y-\mathrm{log\text{-}diff}_Z\lesssim\left(1-\frac{1}{e}\right)\cdot\mathrm{log\text{-}cond}_E
\]
on $U_Y(\overline{\mathbb{Q}})$.

Context (not quotation): Here φ:Y→Z is a generically finite morphism of normal Z-proper Z-flat dimension-two schemes; D and E are effective Z-flat Cartier divisors with reduced generic fibers, D_Q=φ_Q^{-1}(E_Q)_red, finite étale restriction off the divisors, and ramification indices along D_Q dividing e. The statement uses BD-class comparisons (≲), not an exact numerical finite-set inequality.

## Mochizuki-GenEll-Prop1.7-localClaim

Proposition 1.7(i), proof, indented elementary claim; printed/PDF pages: [10].

Fix a prime number $p$ and a positive integer $d$. Then there exists a positive integer $n$ such that for any finite Galois extension $L/K$ of finite extensions of $\mathbb{Q}_p$ with $[L:K]\leq d$, the different ideal of $L/K$ contains $p^n\cdot\mathcal{O}_L$ [where we write $\mathcal{O}_L$ for the ring of integers of $L$].

Context (not quotation): The preceding proof paragraph reduces boundedness of the portion over a finite set Σ of log-diff_Y−log-diff_Z to this elementary local claim. This is supporting background, not the exact new finite-set conductor-extension child.

## Mochizuki-GenEll-Thm2.1-BelyiDescent

Theorem 2.1, proof, first paragraph on printed page 13 (selected complete sentences); printed/PDF pages: [13].

On the other hand, by choosing appropriate normal, $\mathbb{Z}$-proper, $\mathbb{Z}$-flat models for $P$, $X$, we may apply Proposition 1.7, (i) [where we take “$e$” to be 1], to conclude that $\mathrm{log\text{-}diff}_P+\mathrm{log\text{-}cond}_C\lesssim\mathrm{log\text{-}diff}_X+\mathrm{log\text{-}cond}_E$ on $\Xi$. Also, we recall from Proposition 1.6 that $\mathrm{log\text{-}cond}_E\lesssim\mathrm{ht}_E\stackrel{\mathrm{def}}{=}\mathrm{ht}_{\mathcal{O}_X(E)}$ on $\Xi$. Thus, by Proposition 1.4, (i), (iii), we compute to find that

Context (not quotation): On printed page 12, φ:X→P is the noncritical Belyi map unramified over U_P, C={0,1,∞}, and E=φ^{-1}(C)_red. The paragraph continues with the displayed height calculation. The first complete quoted sentence is sufficient for the different/conductor comparison route; the additional sentences show its immediate height consumer.

## Scope and fidelity

Proposition 1.7(i) and its use in Theorem 2.1 establish the paper-level geometric/BD-class different–conductor comparison used by Belyi descent.

BelyiActualFieldConductorExtension fixes F=Tripod.fieldOf(belyiImage M φ x).1 and L=x.fieldOf, finite element sets S⊂F, T⊂L, and the actual field inclusion. Under inclusion(S)⊆T it asks for finiteSetLogCond(S)≤finiteSetLogCond(T)+log(absNorm(differentIdeal(O_F,O_L)))/[L:Q].

The paper does not state this exact finite-set formula or these Lean field definitions. Treat the quoted paragraph as original-paper context, and identify the finite-set inequality as an explicit field-level arithmetic auxiliary lemma implementing that context. Do not put the exact new numeric statement inside quotation marks or claim it is a verbatim theorem of Mochizuki.

BelyiActualFieldDifferentTower separately identifies the full-field log-different with the image-field log-different plus the normalized relative different. The paper quotation does not by itself prove either current Lean child.

Recommended short citation: Mochizuki, *Arithmetic Elliptic Curves in General Position*, February 2009 PDF, Theorem 2.1 proof, printed/PDF p. 13; supporting statement Proposition 1.7(i), pp. 9–10.

For arbitrary types $F,L$ with specified field structures and a specified $F$-algebra structure on $L$, write $\mathcal O_F,\mathcal O_L$ for their rings of integers and $i_{\mathcal O}:\mathcal O_F\to\mathcal O_L$ for the induced algebra map. For every height-one-spectrum element $P$ of $\mathcal O_L$ (a nonzero prime ideal together with its primality and nonzero witnesses), this definition returns the height-one-spectrum element of $\mathcal O_F$ whose underlying ideal is $i_{\mathcal O}^{-1}(P)$. Neither $F$ nor $L$ has a number-field assumption in the compiler type; the definition quantifies over the given algebra structure, rather than choosing one.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ConductorExtensionSource.diffContrib`

For a field $F$, a number field $L$, and an $F$-algebra structure on $L$, let $\mathcal O_E$ denote the ring of integers of $E$. Write $n_E=[E:\mathbb Q]$, $D_{L/F}=\operatorname{differentIdeal}(\mathcal O_F,\mathcal O_L)$ and $\delta_{L/F}(\mathfrak q)=\sum_{P\in\Pi_L(\mathfrak q)}\operatorname{multiplicity}_P(D_{L/F})\log|\mathcal O_L/P|/n_L$, where $\Pi_L(\mathfrak q)$ is the library finite set of prime ideals over the ideal $\mathfrak q$, and multiplicities and norms are cast to $\mathbb R$. For a finite place $v$ of $E$, $\mathfrak p_v$ denotes its associated nonzero prime ideal and $N(v)=|\mathcal O_E/\mathfrak p_v|$. For every ideal $\mathfrak q$ of $\mathcal O_F$, this noncomputable real-valued definition is exactly $\delta_{L/F}(\mathfrak q)$; no nonzero or maximality assumption is imposed on $\mathfrak q$.

For a finite place $v$ of $E$, $\mathfrak p_v$ denotes its associated nonzero prime ideal and $N(v)=|\mathcal O_E/\mathfrak p_v|$. one has $0\le\delta_{L/F}(\mathfrak q)$. No number-field instance for $F$ is assumed in this declaration.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ConductorExtensionSource.primeBelow`

$F,L$ を指定された体構造を持つ任意の型とし、$L$ の $F$ 代数構造を指定する。それぞれの整数環を $\mathcal O_F,\mathcal O_L$、整数環上の誘導代数写像を $i_{\mathcal O}:\mathcal O_F\to\mathcal O_L$ とする。$\mathcal O_L$ の高さ一のスペクトルの任意の元 $P$、すなわち素性と非零性の証明を備えた非零素イデアルに対し、この定義は、底にあるイデアルが $i_{\mathcal O}^{-1}(P)$ である $\mathcal O_F$ の高さ一のスペクトルの元を返す。コンパイラ型には $F$ にも $L$ にも数体の仮定がない。代数構造は定義が選ぶのではなく、与えられた構造として量化される。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ConductorExtensionSource.diffContrib`

$F$ を体、$L$ を数体とし、$L$ の $F$ 代数構造を指定する。$\mathcal O_E$ は $E$ の整数環を表す。$n_E=[E:\mathbb Q]$、$D_{L/F}=\operatorname{differentIdeal}(\mathcal O_F,\mathcal O_L)$（相対デデキント異種イデアル）、$\delta_{L/F}(\mathfrak q)=\sum_{P\in\Pi_L(\mathfrak q)}\operatorname{multiplicity}_P(D_{L/F})\log|\mathcal O_L/P|/n_L$ とおく。ここで $\Pi_L(\mathfrak q)$ はイデアル $\mathfrak q$ の上にある素イデアルからなるライブラリの有限集合であり、重複度とノルムは実数に写して用いる。$E$ の有限素点 $v$ について、$\mathfrak p_v$ は対応する非零素イデアルを表し、$N(v)=|\mathcal O_E/\mathfrak p_v|$ とする。$\mathcal O_F$ の任意のイデアル $\mathfrak q$ に対するこの非計算的実数値定義は $\delta_{L/F}(\mathfrak q)$ そのものである。$\mathfrak q$ が非零または極大であるという仮定はない。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ConductorExtensionSource.diffContrib_nonneg`

任意の体 $F$、$F$ 代数構造を持つ数体 $L$、および $\mathcal O_F$ の任意のイデアル $\mathfrak q$ について、$n_E=[E:\mathbb Q]$、$D_{L/F}=\operatorname{differentIdeal}(\mathcal O_F,\mathcal O_L)$（相対デデキント異種イデアル）、$\delta_{L/F}(\mathfrak q)=\sum_{P\in\Pi_L(\mathfrak q)}\operatorname{multiplicity}_P(D_{L/F})\log|\mathcal O_L/P|/n_L$ とおく。ここで $\Pi_L(\mathfrak q)$ はイデアル $\mathfrak q$ の上にある素イデアルからなるライブラリの有限集合であり、重複度とノルムは実数に写して用いる。$E$ の有限素点 $v$ について、$\mathfrak p_v$ は対応する非零素イデアルを表し、$N(v)=|\mathcal O_E/\mathfrak p_v|$ とする。$0\le\delta_{L/F}(\mathfrak q)$ が成り立つ。この宣言では $F$ に数体のインスタンスを仮定しない。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ConductorExtensionSource.mem_primesOverFinset_iff'`

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ConductorExtensionSource.finitePlace_apply_eq`

任意の数体 $K$（$\mathbb Q$ 上有限次元の体）について、その整数環を $\mathcal O_K$ とする。$K$ の有限素点 $w$ に対応する非零素イデアルを $\mathfrak p_w$ とし、$N(w)=|\mathcal O_K/\mathfrak p_w|$ とおく。任意の有限素点 $w$ と $x\in K$ に対し、$w(x)$ は $\tau_{N(w)}(v_{\mathfrak p_w}(x))$ を実数に写した値に等しい。ここで $v_{\mathfrak p_w}:K\to\mathbb Z_{\mathrm{mult}}\cup\{0\}$ は乗法的整数と付加した零を値域とする付値であり、$\tau_e(0)=0$、$\tau_e(\operatorname{ofAdd}(z))=e^{-z}$ である。底の非零性にはイデアルノルムの非零性を用いる。$x=0$ も含まれる。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ConductorExtensionSource.toNNReal_congr`

指定された非零性の証明 $h_e:e\ne0$ を持つ非負実数 $e$ について、$\tau_e$ を零を付加した乗法的整数から非負実数への写像とし、$\tau_e(0)=0$、$\tau_e(\operatorname{ofAdd}(z))=e^{-z}$ と定義する。任意の非負実数 $e,e^{\prime}$、等式の証明 $h:e=e^{\prime}$、それぞれの非零性の証明 $h_e,h_{e^{\prime}}$、および任意の入力 $m$ に対して $\tau_e(m)=\tau_{e^{\prime}}(m)$ が成り立つ。両方の非零性の証明を量化する。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ConductorExtensionSource.toNNReal_pow_base`

指定された非零性の証明 $h_e:e\ne0$ を持つ非負実数 $e$ について、$\tau_e$ を零を付加した乗法的整数から非負実数への写像とし、$\tau_e(0)=0$、$\tau_e(\operatorname{ofAdd}(z))=e^{-z}$ と定義する。任意のそのような $e,h_e$、非零性の証明 $h_f:f\ne0$ を持つ自然数 $f$、証明 $h_{ef}:e^f\ne0$、および零も含む任意の入力 $m$ について、$\tau_{e^f}(m)=\tau_e(m)^f$ が成り立つ。左辺の写像には $h_{ef}$ を用いる。

import Definitions.Def_FermatBelyiDifferentConductorChildren
import Mathlib.NumberTheory.RamificationInertia.Basic
import Mathlib.NumberTheory.RamificationInertia.Valuation

set_option autoImplicit false
open NumberField IsDedekindDomain Module
open scoped Classical IntermediateField

namespace AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ConductorExtensionSource

section DifferentCarriers

variable {F : Type*} [Field F] [NumberField F] (L : Type*) [Field L] [NumberField L]
  [Algebra F L]

/-- The prime of `F` below a prime of `L`. -/
def primeBelow (P : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 L)) : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 F) where
  asIdeal := P.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap (𝓞 F) (𝓞 L))
  isPrime := Ideal.IsPrime.comap _
  ne_bot := fun h => P.ne_bot (Ideal.eq_bot_of_comap_eq_bot h)

/-- The contribution of the primes of `L` over `𝔭` to `log N(𝔇_{L/F}) / [L : ℚ]`:
`∑_{P ∣ 𝔭} ord_P(𝔇)·log N(P) / [L : ℚ]`. -/
noncomputable def diffContrib (𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 F)) : ℝ :=
  ∑ P ∈ IsDedekindDomain.primesOverFinset 𝔭 (𝓞 L),
    (multiplicity P (differentIdeal (𝓞 F) (𝓞 L)) : ℝ) * Real.log (Ideal.absNorm P) /
      finrank ℚ L

variable {L}

omit [NumberField F] in
lemma diffContrib_nonneg (𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 F)) : 0 ≤ diffContrib L 𝔭 :=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity)
    (Real.log_natCast_nonneg _)) (by positivity)

omit [NumberField F] in
lemma mem_primesOverFinset_iff' {𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 F)} [𝔭.IsMaximal] (h𝔭 : 𝔭 ≠ ⊥)
    {P : Ideal (𝓞 L)} :
    P ∈ IsDedekindDomain.primesOverFinset 𝔭 (𝓞 L) ↔ P.IsPrime ∧ P.LiesOver 𝔭 := by
  rw [IsDedekindDomain.mem_primesOverFinset_iff h𝔭]
  rfl

end DifferentCarriers

/-! ### The absolute norm of a finite place -/

section Norm

variable {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K]

/-- The absolute norm `N(w) = #(𝓞 K / 𝔭_w)` of a finite place. -/
noncomputable def placeNorm (w : FinitePlace K) : ℕ := Ideal.absNorm w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal

lemma one_lt_placeNorm (w : FinitePlace K) : 1 < placeNorm w :=
  NumberField.HeightOneSpectrum.one_lt_absNorm w.maximalIdeal

lemma log_placeNorm_pos (w : FinitePlace K) : 0 < Real.log (placeNorm w) :=
  Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast one_lt_placeNorm w)

lemma log_placeNorm_nonneg (w : FinitePlace K) : 0 ≤ Real.log (placeNorm w) :=
  (log_placeNorm_pos w).le

/-- `w x = N(w)^{-ord_w x}`, in the form of Mathlib's `toNNReal`. -/
lemma finitePlace_apply_eq (w : FinitePlace K) (x : K) :
    w x = (WithZeroMulInt.toNNReal (HeightOneSpectrum.absNorm_ne_zero w.maximalIdeal)
      (w.maximalIdeal.valuation K x) : ℝ) := by
  rw [← FinitePlace.norm_embedding_eq, FinitePlace.norm_embedding']

end Norm

/-! ### `toNNReal` under powers of the base -/

section ToNNReal

open WithZeroMulInt

lemma toNNReal_congr {e e' : NNReal} (h : e = e') (he : e ≠ 0) (he' : e' ≠ 0)
    (m : WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)) :
    toNNReal he m = toNNReal he' m := by
  subst h
  rfl

/-- `toNNReal_{e^f}(m) = toNNReal_e(m)^f` for `f ≠ 0`. -/
lemma toNNReal_pow_base {e : NNReal} (he : e ≠ 0) {f : ℕ} (hf : f ≠ 0) (hef : e ^ f ≠ 0)
    (m : WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)) : toNNReal hef m = toNNReal he m ^ f := by
  by_cases hm : m = 0
  · subst hm
    rw [map_zero, map_zero, zero_pow hf]
  · rw [toNNReal_neg_apply hef hm, toNNReal_neg_apply he hm, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_natCast,
      ← zpow_mul, ← zpow_mul, mul_comm]

end ToNNReal

/-! ### Places over places -/

section LiesOver

variable {F L : Type*} [Field F] [NumberField F] [Field L] [NumberField L] [Algebra F L]

/-- The finite place `w` of `L` lies over the finite place `u` of `F`:
`𝔭_w ∩ 𝓞 F = 𝔭_u`. -/
abbrev PlaceLiesOver (w : FinitePlace L) (u : FinitePlace F) : Prop :=
  w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal.LiesOver u.maximalIdeal.asIdeal

/-- The ramification index `e(w|u)`. -/
noncomputable abbrev placeRamIdx (w : FinitePlace L) (u : FinitePlace F) : ℕ :=
  u.maximalIdeal.asIdeal.ramificationIdx' w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal

/-- The inertia degree `f(w|u)`. -/
noncomputable abbrev placeInertiaDeg (w : FinitePlace L) (u : FinitePlace F) : ℕ :=
  u.maximalIdeal.asIdeal.inertiaDeg' w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal

lemma placeRamIdx_ne_zero {w : FinitePlace L} {u : FinitePlace F} (h : PlaceLiesOver w u) :
    placeRamIdx w u ≠ 0 :=
  Ideal.IsDedekindDomain.ramificationIdx'_ne_zero_of_liesOver _ u.maximalIdeal.ne_bot

lemma placeInertiaDeg_ne_zero {w : FinitePlace L} {u : FinitePlace F} (h : PlaceLiesOver w u) :
    placeInertiaDeg w u ≠ 0 := by
  haveI := u.maximalIdeal.isMaximal
  exact (Ideal.inertiaDeg'_pos _ _).ne'

/-- **`N(w) = N(u)^f`** for `w` over `u`. -/
theorem placeNorm_eq_pow {w : FinitePlace L} {u : FinitePlace F} (h : PlaceLiesOver w u) :
    placeNorm w = placeNorm u ^ placeInertiaDeg w u :=
  Ideal.absNorm_eq_pow_inertiaDeg'_of_liesOver _ _ inferInstance u.maximalIdeal.ne_bot

/-- **`w (a) = u (a)^{e·f}`** for `a ∈ F` and `w` over `u`. -/
theorem apply_algebraMap_eq_pow {w : FinitePlace L} {u : FinitePlace F} (h : PlaceLiesOver w u)
    (a : F) : w (algebraMap F L a) = u a ^ (placeRamIdx w u * placeInertiaDeg w u) := by
  rw [finitePlace_apply_eq, finitePlace_apply_eq,
    ← HeightOneSpectrum.valuation_liesOver L u.maximalIdeal w.maximalIdeal, map_pow]
  have hN : (Ideal.absNorm w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal : NNReal) =
      (Ideal.absNorm u.maximalIdeal.asIdeal : NNReal) ^ placeInertiaDeg w u := by
    exact_mod_cast placeNorm_eq_pow h
  rw [toNNReal_congr hN _ (pow_ne_zero _ (HeightOneSpectrum.absNorm_ne_zero _)),
    toNNReal_pow_base (HeightOneSpectrum.absNorm_ne_zero _) (placeInertiaDeg_ne_zero h),
    ← pow_mul, NNReal.coe_pow, mul_comm]

/-- `u (a) = 1 → w (a) = 1`, and more generally `1 < u a ↔ 1 < w a`. -/
lemma one_lt_apply_algebraMap_iff {w : FinitePlace L} {u : FinitePlace F}
    (h : PlaceLiesOver w u) (a : F) : 1 < w (algebraMap F L a) ↔ 1 < u a := by
  rw [apply_algebraMap_eq_pow h]
  exact one_lt_pow_iff_of_nonneg (apply_nonneg u a)
    (mul_ne_zero (placeRamIdx_ne_zero h) (placeInertiaDeg_ne_zero h))

/-! #### The place below -/

variable (L) in
/-- The finite place of `F` below a finite place of `L`. -/
noncomputable def placeBelow (w : FinitePlace L) : FinitePlace F :=
  FinitePlace.mk (primeBelow L w.maximalIdeal)

lemma placeBelow_maximalIdeal (w : FinitePlace L) :
    (placeBelow L w : FinitePlace F).maximalIdeal = primeBelow L w.maximalIdeal :=
  FinitePlace.maximalIdeal_mk _

/-- **The place below is unique**: if `w` lies over `u`, then `u` is the place below `w`. -/
theorem eq_placeBelow {w : FinitePlace L} {u : FinitePlace F} (h : PlaceLiesOver w u) :
    u = placeBelow L w := by
  rw [← FinitePlace.maximalIdeal_inj]
  apply HeightOneSpectrum.ext
  rw [placeBelow_maximalIdeal]
  exact h.over

lemma mem_primesOverFinset_of_placeLiesOver {w : FinitePlace L} {u : FinitePlace F}
    (h : PlaceLiesOver w u) :
    w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal ∈ IsDedekindDomain.primesOverFinset u.maximalIdeal.asIdeal (𝓞 L) := by
  haveI := u.maximalIdeal.isMaximal
  exact (mem_primesOverFinset_iff' u.maximalIdeal.ne_bot).mpr ⟨w.maximalIdeal.isPrime, h⟩

variable (L) in
/-- The finitely many places of `L` over `u`. -/
lemma finite_placeLiesOver (u : FinitePlace F) :
    {w : FinitePlace L | PlaceLiesOver w u}.Finite := by
  refine Set.Finite.of_finite_image ?_
    (f := fun w : FinitePlace L => w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal) ?_
  · refine (IsDedekindDomain.primesOverFinset u.maximalIdeal.asIdeal
      (𝓞 L)).finite_toSet.subset ?_
    rintro _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    exact mem_primesOverFinset_of_placeLiesOver hw
  · intro w₁ _ w₂ _ h
    exact (FinitePlace.maximalIdeal_inj _ _).mp (HeightOneSpectrum.ext h)

variable (L) in
/-- The finite set of places of `L` over `u`. -/
noncomputable def placesOver (u : FinitePlace F) : Finset (FinitePlace L) :=
  (finite_placeLiesOver L u).toFinset

lemma mem_placesOver {u : FinitePlace F} {w : FinitePlace L} :
    w ∈ placesOver L u ↔ PlaceLiesOver w u := by
  rw [placesOver, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Set.mem_setOf_eq]

end LiesOver

end AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ConductorExtensionSource

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ConductorExtensionSource.primeBelow`

$F,L$ を指定された体構造を持つ任意の型とし、$L$ の $F$ 代数構造を指定する。それぞれの整数環を $\mathcal O_F,\mathcal O_L$、整数環上の誘導代数写像を $i_{\mathcal O}:\mathcal O_F\to\mathcal O_L$ とする。$\mathcal O_L$ の高さ一のスペクトルの任意の元 $P$、すなわち素性と非零性の証明を備えた非零素イデアルに対し、この定義は、底にあるイデアルが $i_{\mathcal O}^{-1}(P)$ である $\mathcal O_F$ の高さ一のスペクトルの元を返す。コンパイラ型には $F$ にも $L$ にも数体の仮定がない。代数構造は定義が選ぶのではなく、与えられた構造として量化される。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ConductorExtensionSource.diffContrib`

$F$ を体、$L$ を数体とし、$L$ の $F$ 代数構造を指定する。$\mathcal O_E$ は $E$ の整数環を表す。$n_E=[E:\mathbb Q]$、$D_{L/F}=\operatorname{differentIdeal}(\mathcal O_F,\mathcal O_L)$（相対デデキント異種イデアル）、$\delta_{L/F}(\mathfrak q)=\sum_{P\in\Pi_L(\mathfrak q)}\operatorname{multiplicity}_P(D_{L/F})\log|\mathcal O_L/P|/n_L$ とおく。ここで $\Pi_L(\mathfrak q)$ はイデアル $\mathfrak q$ の上にある素イデアルからなるライブラリの有限集合であり、重複度とノルムは実数に写して用いる。$E$ の有限素点 $v$ について、$\mathfrak p_v$ は対応する非零素イデアルを表し、$N(v)=|\mathcal O_E/\mathfrak p_v|$ とする。$\mathcal O_F$ の任意のイデアル $\mathfrak q$ に対するこの非計算的実数値定義は $\delta_{L/F}(\mathfrak q)$ そのものである。$\mathfrak q$ が非零または極大であるという仮定はない。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ConductorExtensionSource.diffContrib_nonneg`

任意の体 $F$、$F$ 代数構造を持つ数体 $L$、および $\mathcal O_F$ の任意のイデアル $\mathfrak q$ について、$n_E=[E:\mathbb Q]$、$D_{L/F}=\operatorname{differentIdeal}(\mathcal O_F,\mathcal O_L)$（相対デデキント異種イデアル）、$\delta_{L/F}(\mathfrak q)=\sum_{P\in\Pi_L(\mathfrak q)}\operatorname{multiplicity}_P(D_{L/F})\log|\mathcal O_L/P|/n_L$ とおく。ここで $\Pi_L(\mathfrak q)$ はイデアル $\mathfrak q$ の上にある素イデアルからなるライブラリの有限集合であり、重複度とノルムは実数に写して用いる。$E$ の有限素点 $v$ について、$\mathfrak p_v$ は対応する非零素イデアルを表し、$N(v)=|\mathcal O_E/\mathfrak p_v|$ とする。$0\le\delta_{L/F}(\mathfrak q)$ が成り立つ。この宣言では $F$ に数体のインスタンスを仮定しない。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ConductorExtensionSource.mem_primesOverFinset_iff'`

$F$ を体、$L$ を $F$ 代数構造を持つ数体とする。極大性のインスタンスを持つ $\mathcal O_F$ の任意の非零極大イデアル $\mathfrak q$ と、$\mathcal O_L$ の任意のイデアル $P$ に対し、$P$ がライブラリの有限集合 $\Pi_L(\mathfrak q)$ に属することと、$P$ が素イデアルで $\mathcal O_F\to\mathcal O_L$ による逆像が $\mathfrak q$ であることとは同値である。$F$ の数体インスタンスは省かれる。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ConductorExtensionSource.finitePlace_apply_eq`

任意の数体 $K$（$\mathbb Q$ 上有限次元の体）について、その整数環を $\mathcal O_K$ とする。$K$ の有限素点 $w$ に対応する非零素イデアルを $\mathfrak p_w$ とし、$N(w)=|\mathcal O_K/\mathfrak p_w|$ とおく。任意の有限素点 $w$ と $x\in K$ に対し、$w(x)$ は $\tau_{N(w)}(v_{\mathfrak p_w}(x))$ を実数に写した値に等しい。ここで $v_{\mathfrak p_w}:K\to\mathbb Z_{\mathrm{mult}}\cup\{0\}$ は乗法的整数と付加した零を値域とする付値であり、$\tau_e(0)=0$、$\tau_e(\operatorname{ofAdd}(z))=e^{-z}$ である。底の非零性にはイデアルノルムの非零性を用いる。$x=0$ も含まれる。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ConductorExtensionSource.primeBelow`

For arbitrary types $F,L$ with specified field structures and a specified $F$-algebra structure on $L$, write $\mathcal O_F,\mathcal O_L$ for their rings of integers and $i_{\mathcal O}:\mathcal O_F\to\mathcal O_L$ for the induced algebra map. For every height-one-spectrum element $P$ of $\mathcal O_L$ (a nonzero prime ideal together with its primality and nonzero witnesses), this definition returns the height-one-spectrum element of $\mathcal O_F$ whose underlying ideal is $i_{\mathcal O}^{-1}(P)$. Neither $F$ nor $L$ has a number-field assumption in the compiler type; the definition quantifies over the given algebra structure, rather than choosing one.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ConductorExtensionSource.diffContrib`

For a field $F$, a number field $L$, and an $F$-algebra structure on $L$, let $\mathcal O_E$ denote the ring of integers of $E$. Write $n_E=[E:\mathbb Q]$, $D_{L/F}=\operatorname{differentIdeal}(\mathcal O_F,\mathcal O_L)$ and $\delta_{L/F}(\mathfrak q)=\sum_{P\in\Pi_L(\mathfrak q)}\operatorname{multiplicity}_P(D_{L/F})\log|\mathcal O_L/P|/n_L$, where $\Pi_L(\mathfrak q)$ is the library finite set of prime ideals over the ideal $\mathfrak q$, and multiplicities and norms are cast to $\mathbb R$. For a finite place $v$ of $E$, $\mathfrak p_v$ denotes its associated nonzero prime ideal and $N(v)=|\mathcal O_E/\mathfrak p_v|$. For every ideal $\mathfrak q$ of $\mathcal O_F$, this noncomputable real-valued definition is exactly $\delta_{L/F}(\mathfrak q)$; no nonzero or maximality assumption is imposed on $\mathfrak q$.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ConductorExtensionSource.diffContrib_nonneg`

For every field $F$, number field $L$ with an $F$-algebra structure, and ideal $\mathfrak q$ of $\mathcal O_F$, Write $n_E=[E:\mathbb Q]$, $D_{L/F}=\operatorname{differentIdeal}(\mathcal O_F,\mathcal O_L)$ and $\delta_{L/F}(\mathfrak q)=\sum_{P\in\Pi_L(\mathfrak q)}\operatorname{multiplicity}_P(D_{L/F})\log|\mathcal O_L/P|/n_L$, where $\Pi_L(\mathfrak q)$ is the library finite set of prime ideals over the ideal $\mathfrak q$, and multiplicities and norms are cast to $\mathbb R$. For a finite place $v$ of $E$, $\mathfrak p_v$ denotes its associated nonzero prime ideal and $N(v)=|\mathcal O_E/\mathfrak p_v|$. one has $0\le\delta_{L/F}(\mathfrak q)$. No number-field instance for $F$ is assumed in this declaration.

For a field $F$, a number field $L$ with an $F$-algebra structure, every nonzero maximal ideal $\mathfrak q$ of $\mathcal O_F$ with its maximality instance, and every ideal $P$ of $\mathcal O_L$, membership of $P$ in the library finite set $\Pi_L(\mathfrak q)$ is equivalent to the conjunction that $P$ is prime and the inverse image of $P$ under $\mathcal O_F\to\mathcal O_L$ equals $\mathfrak q$. A number-field instance for $F$ is omitted.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ConductorExtensionSource.placeNorm`

For every number field $K$ (a field finite dimensional over $\mathbb Q$), write $\mathcal O_K$ for its ring of integers. For a finite place $w$ of $K$, let $\mathfrak p_w$ be its associated nonzero prime ideal and $N(w)=|\mathcal O_K/\mathfrak p_w|$. This noncomputable function from finite places of $K$ to $\mathbb N$ returns exactly $N(w)$.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ConductorExtensionSource.one_lt_placeNorm`

For every number field $K$ (a field finite dimensional over $\mathbb Q$), write $\mathcal O_K$ for its ring of integers. For a finite place $w$ of $K$, let $\mathfrak p_w$ be its associated nonzero prime ideal and $N(w)=|\mathcal O_K/\mathfrak p_w|$. For every such $w$, $1<N(w)$.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ConductorExtensionSource.primeBelow`

$F,L$ を指定された体構造を持つ任意の型とし、$L$ の $F$ 代数構造を指定する。それぞれの整数環を $\mathcal O_F,\mathcal O_L$、整数環上の誘導代数写像を $i_{\mathcal O}:\mathcal O_F\to\mathcal O_L$ とする。$\mathcal O_L$ の高さ一のスペクトルの任意の元 $P$、すなわち素性と非零性の証明を備えた非零素イデアルに対し、この定義は、底にあるイデアルが $i_{\mathcal O}^{-1}(P)$ である $\mathcal O_F$ の高さ一のスペクトルの元を返す。コンパイラ型には $F$ にも $L$ にも数体の仮定がない。代数構造は定義が選ぶのではなく、与えられた構造として量化される。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ConductorExtensionSource.diffContrib`

$F$ を体、$L$ を数体とし、$L$ の $F$ 代数構造を指定する。$\mathcal O_E$ は $E$ の整数環を表す。$n_E=[E:\mathbb Q]$、$D_{L/F}=\operatorname{differentIdeal}(\mathcal O_F,\mathcal O_L)$（相対デデキント異種イデアル）、$\delta_{L/F}(\mathfrak q)=\sum_{P\in\Pi_L(\mathfrak q)}\operatorname{multiplicity}_P(D_{L/F})\log|\mathcal O_L/P|/n_L$ とおく。ここで $\Pi_L(\mathfrak q)$ はイデアル $\mathfrak q$ の上にある素イデアルからなるライブラリの有限集合であり、重複度とノルムは実数に写して用いる。$E$ の有限素点 $v$ について、$\mathfrak p_v$ は対応する非零素イデアルを表し、$N(v)=|\mathcal O_E/\mathfrak p_v|$ とする。$\mathcal O_F$ の任意のイデアル $\mathfrak q$ に対するこの非計算的実数値定義は $\delta_{L/F}(\mathfrak q)$ そのものである。$\mathfrak q$ が非零または極大であるという仮定はない。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ConductorExtensionSource.diffContrib_nonneg`

任意の体 $F$、$F$ 代数構造を持つ数体 $L$、および $\mathcal O_F$ の任意のイデアル $\mathfrak q$ について、$n_E=[E:\mathbb Q]$、$D_{L/F}=\operatorname{differentIdeal}(\mathcal O_F,\mathcal O_L)$（相対デデキント異種イデアル）、$\delta_{L/F}(\mathfrak q)=\sum_{P\in\Pi_L(\mathfrak q)}\operatorname{multiplicity}_P(D_{L/F})\log|\mathcal O_L/P|/n_L$ とおく。ここで $\Pi_L(\mathfrak q)$ はイデアル $\mathfrak q$ の上にある素イデアルからなるライブラリの有限集合であり、重複度とノルムは実数に写して用いる。$E$ の有限素点 $v$ について、$\mathfrak p_v$ は対応する非零素イデアルを表し、$N(v)=|\mathcal O_E/\mathfrak p_v|$ とする。$0\le\delta_{L/F}(\mathfrak q)$ が成り立つ。この宣言では $F$ に数体のインスタンスを仮定しない。

import Definitions.Def_FermatBelyiDifferentConductorChildren
import Mathlib.NumberTheory.RamificationInertia.Basic
import Mathlib.NumberTheory.RamificationInertia.Valuation

set_option autoImplicit false
open NumberField IsDedekindDomain Module
open scoped Classical IntermediateField

namespace AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ConductorExtensionSource

section DifferentCarriers

variable {F : Type*} [Field F] [NumberField F] (L : Type*) [Field L] [NumberField L]
  [Algebra F L]

/-- The prime of `F` below a prime of `L`. -/
def primeBelow (P : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 L)) : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 F) where
  asIdeal := P.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap (𝓞 F) (𝓞 L))
  isPrime := Ideal.IsPrime.comap _
  ne_bot := fun h => P.ne_bot (Ideal.eq_bot_of_comap_eq_bot h)

/-- The contribution of the primes of `L` over `𝔭` to `log N(𝔇_{L/F}) / [L : ℚ]`:
`∑_{P ∣ 𝔭} ord_P(𝔇)·log N(P) / [L : ℚ]`. -/
noncomputable def diffContrib (𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 F)) : ℝ :=
  ∑ P ∈ IsDedekindDomain.primesOverFinset 𝔭 (𝓞 L),
    (multiplicity P (differentIdeal (𝓞 F) (𝓞 L)) : ℝ) * Real.log (Ideal.absNorm P) /
      finrank ℚ L

variable {L}

omit [NumberField F] in
lemma diffContrib_nonneg (𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 F)) : 0 ≤ diffContrib L 𝔭 :=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity)
    (Real.log_natCast_nonneg _)) (by positivity)

omit [NumberField F] in
lemma mem_primesOverFinset_iff' {𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 F)} [𝔭.IsMaximal] (h𝔭 : 𝔭 ≠ ⊥)
    {P : Ideal (𝓞 L)} :
    P ∈ IsDedekindDomain.primesOverFinset 𝔭 (𝓞 L) ↔ P.IsPrime ∧ P.LiesOver 𝔭 := by
  rw [IsDedekindDomain.mem_primesOverFinset_iff h𝔭]
  rfl

end DifferentCarriers

/-! ### The absolute norm of a finite place -/

section Norm

variable {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K]

/-- The absolute norm `N(w) = #(𝓞 K / 𝔭_w)` of a finite place. -/
noncomputable def placeNorm (w : FinitePlace K) : ℕ := Ideal.absNorm w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal

lemma one_lt_placeNorm (w : FinitePlace K) : 1 < placeNorm w :=
  NumberField.HeightOneSpectrum.one_lt_absNorm w.maximalIdeal

lemma log_placeNorm_pos (w : FinitePlace K) : 0 < Real.log (placeNorm w) :=
  Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast one_lt_placeNorm w)

lemma log_placeNorm_nonneg (w : FinitePlace K) : 0 ≤ Real.log (placeNorm w) :=
  (log_placeNorm_pos w).le

/-- `w x = N(w)^{-ord_w x}`, in the form of Mathlib's `toNNReal`. -/
lemma finitePlace_apply_eq (w : FinitePlace K) (x : K) :
    w x = (WithZeroMulInt.toNNReal (HeightOneSpectrum.absNorm_ne_zero w.maximalIdeal)
      (w.maximalIdeal.valuation K x) : ℝ) := by
  rw [← FinitePlace.norm_embedding_eq, FinitePlace.norm_embedding']

end Norm

/-! ### `toNNReal` under powers of the base -/

section ToNNReal

open WithZeroMulInt

lemma toNNReal_congr {e e' : NNReal} (h : e = e') (he : e ≠ 0) (he' : e' ≠ 0)
    (m : WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)) :
    toNNReal he m = toNNReal he' m := by
  subst h
  rfl

/-- `toNNReal_{e^f}(m) = toNNReal_e(m)^f` for `f ≠ 0`. -/
lemma toNNReal_pow_base {e : NNReal} (he : e ≠ 0) {f : ℕ} (hf : f ≠ 0) (hef : e ^ f ≠ 0)
    (m : WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)) : toNNReal hef m = toNNReal he m ^ f := by
  by_cases hm : m = 0
  · subst hm
    rw [map_zero, map_zero, zero_pow hf]
  · rw [toNNReal_neg_apply hef hm, toNNReal_neg_apply he hm, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_natCast,
      ← zpow_mul, ← zpow_mul, mul_comm]

end ToNNReal

/-! ### Places over places -/

section LiesOver

variable {F L : Type*} [Field F] [NumberField F] [Field L] [NumberField L] [Algebra F L]

/-- The finite place `w` of `L` lies over the finite place `u` of `F`:
`𝔭_w ∩ 𝓞 F = 𝔭_u`. -/
abbrev PlaceLiesOver (w : FinitePlace L) (u : FinitePlace F) : Prop :=
  w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal.LiesOver u.maximalIdeal.asIdeal

/-- The ramification index `e(w|u)`. -/
noncomputable abbrev placeRamIdx (w : FinitePlace L) (u : FinitePlace F) : ℕ :=
  u.maximalIdeal.asIdeal.ramificationIdx' w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal

/-- The inertia degree `f(w|u)`. -/
noncomputable abbrev placeInertiaDeg (w : FinitePlace L) (u : FinitePlace F) : ℕ :=
  u.maximalIdeal.asIdeal.inertiaDeg' w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal

lemma placeRamIdx_ne_zero {w : FinitePlace L} {u : FinitePlace F} (h : PlaceLiesOver w u) :
    placeRamIdx w u ≠ 0 :=
  Ideal.IsDedekindDomain.ramificationIdx'_ne_zero_of_liesOver _ u.maximalIdeal.ne_bot

  haveI := u.maximalIdeal.isMaximal
  exact (Ideal.inertiaDeg'_pos _ _).ne'

theorem placeNorm_eq_pow {w : FinitePlace L} {u : FinitePlace F} (h : PlaceLiesOver w u) :
    placeNorm w = placeNorm u ^ placeInertiaDeg w u :=
  Ideal.absNorm_eq_pow_inertiaDeg'_of_liesOver _ _ inferInstance u.maximalIdeal.ne_bot

theorem apply_algebraMap_eq_pow {w : FinitePlace L} {u : FinitePlace F} (h : PlaceLiesOver w u)
    (a : F) : w (algebraMap F L a) = u a ^ (placeRamIdx w u * placeInertiaDeg w u) := by
  rw [finitePlace_apply_eq, finitePlace_apply_eq,
    ← HeightOneSpectrum.valuation_liesOver L u.maximalIdeal w.maximalIdeal, map_pow]
  have hN : (Ideal.absNorm w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal : NNReal) =

    exact_mod_cast placeNorm_eq_pow h

    toNNReal_pow_base (HeightOneSpectrum.absNorm_ne_zero _) (placeInertiaDeg_ne_zero h),
    ← pow_mul, NNReal.coe_pow, mul_comm]

/-- The finite place of `F` below a finite place of `L`. -/
noncomputable def placeBelow (w : FinitePlace L) : FinitePlace F :=
  FinitePlace.mk (primeBelow L w.maximalIdeal)

lemma placeBelow_maximalIdeal (w : FinitePlace L) :
    (placeBelow L w : FinitePlace F).maximalIdeal = primeBelow L w.maximalIdeal :=
  FinitePlace.maximalIdeal_mk _

/-- **The place below is unique**: if `w` lies over `u`, then `u` is the place below `w`. -/
theorem eq_placeBelow {w : FinitePlace L} {u : FinitePlace F} (h : PlaceLiesOver w u) :
    u = placeBelow L w := by
  rw [← FinitePlace.maximalIdeal_inj]
  apply HeightOneSpectrum.ext
  rw [placeBelow_maximalIdeal]
  exact h.over

lemma mem_primesOverFinset_of_placeLiesOver {w : FinitePlace L} {u : FinitePlace F}
    (h : PlaceLiesOver w u) :
    w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal ∈ IsDedekindDomain.primesOverFinset u.maximalIdeal.asIdeal (𝓞 L) := by
  haveI := u.maximalIdeal.isMaximal
  exact (mem_primesOverFinset_iff' u.maximalIdeal.ne_bot).mpr ⟨w.maximalIdeal.isPrime, h⟩

/-- The finitely many places of `L` over `u`. -/

    {w : FinitePlace L | PlaceLiesOver w u}.Finite := by
  refine Set.Finite.of_finite_image ?_
    (f := fun w : FinitePlace L => w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal) ?_
  · refine (IsDedekindDomain.primesOverFinset u.maximalIdeal.asIdeal
      (𝓞 L)).finite_toSet.subset ?_
    rintro _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    exact mem_primesOverFinset_of_placeLiesOver hw
  · intro w₁ _ w₂ _ h
    exact (FinitePlace.maximalIdeal_inj _ _).mp (HeightOneSpectrum.ext h)

variable (L) in
/-- The finite set of places of `L` over `u`. -/
noncomputable def placesOver (u : FinitePlace F) : Finset (FinitePlace L) :=
  (finite_placeLiesOver L u).toFinset

lemma mem_placesOver {u : FinitePlace F} {w : FinitePlace L} :
    w ∈ placesOver L u ↔ PlaceLiesOver w u := by
  rw [placesOver, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Set.mem_setOf_eq]

Authors: The heights contributors

Independent source adaptation; source mappings are recorded in SOURCE_LEDGER.md.
-/
import Definitions.Def_FermatBelyiDifferentConductorChildren
import Mathlib.NumberTheory.RamificationInertia.Basic
import Mathlib.NumberTheory.RamificationInertia.Valuation

set_option autoImplicit false
open NumberField IsDedekindDomain Module
open scoped Classical IntermediateField

namespace AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ConductorExtensionSource

section DifferentCarriers

variable {F : Type*} [Field F] [NumberField F] (L : Type*) [Field L] [NumberField L]
  [Algebra F L]

/-- The prime of `F` below a prime of `L`. -/
def primeBelow (P : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 L)) : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 F) where
  asIdeal := P.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap (𝓞 F) (𝓞 L))
  isPrime := Ideal.IsPrime.comap _
  ne_bot := fun h => P.ne_bot (Ideal.eq_bot_of_comap_eq_bot h)

/-- The contribution of the primes of `L` over `𝔭` to `log N(𝔇_{L/F}) / [L : ℚ]`:
`∑_{P ∣ 𝔭} ord_P(𝔇)·log N(P) / [L : ℚ]`. -/
noncomputable def diffContrib (𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 F)) : ℝ :=
  ∑ P ∈ IsDedekindDomain.primesOverFinset 𝔭 (𝓞 L),
    (multiplicity P (differentIdeal (𝓞 F) (𝓞 L)) : ℝ) * Real.log (Ideal.absNorm P) /
      finrank ℚ L

variable {L}

omit [NumberField F] in
lemma diffContrib_nonneg (𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 F)) : 0 ≤ diffContrib L 𝔭 :=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity)
    (Real.log_natCast_nonneg _)) (by positivity)

omit [NumberField F] in
lemma mem_primesOverFinset_iff' {𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 F)} [𝔭.IsMaximal] (h𝔭 : 𝔭 ≠ ⊥)
    {P : Ideal (𝓞 L)} :
    P ∈ IsDedekindDomain.primesOverFinset 𝔭 (𝓞 L) ↔ P.IsPrime ∧ P.LiesOver 𝔭 := by
  rw [IsDedekindDomain.mem_primesOverFinset_iff h𝔭]
  rfl

end DifferentCarriers

/-! ### The absolute norm of a finite place -/

section Norm

variable {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K]

/-- The absolute norm `N(w) = #(𝓞 K / 𝔭_w)` of a finite place. -/
noncomputable def placeNorm (w : FinitePlace K) : ℕ := Ideal.absNorm w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal

lemma one_lt_placeNorm (w : FinitePlace K) : 1 < placeNorm w :=
  NumberField.HeightOneSpectrum.one_lt_absNorm w.maximalIdeal

lemma log_placeNorm_pos (w : FinitePlace K) : 0 < Real.log (placeNorm w) :=
  Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast one_lt_placeNorm w)

lemma log_placeNorm_nonneg (w : FinitePlace K) : 0 ≤ Real.log (placeNorm w) :=
  (log_placeNorm_pos w).le

/-- `w x = N(w)^{-ord_w x}`, in the form of Mathlib's `toNNReal`. -/
lemma finitePlace_apply_eq (w : FinitePlace K) (x : K) :
    w x = (WithZeroMulInt.toNNReal (HeightOneSpectrum.absNorm_ne_zero w.maximalIdeal)
      (w.maximalIdeal.valuation K x) : ℝ) := by
  rw [← FinitePlace.norm_embedding_eq, FinitePlace.norm_embedding']

end Norm

/-! ### `toNNReal` under powers of the base -/

section ToNNReal

open WithZeroMulInt

lemma toNNReal_congr {e e' : NNReal} (h : e = e') (he : e ≠ 0) (he' : e' ≠ 0)
    (m : WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)) :
    toNNReal he m = toNNReal he' m := by
  subst h
  rfl

/-- `toNNReal_{e^f}(m) = toNNReal_e(m)^f` for `f ≠ 0`. -/
lemma toNNReal_pow_base {e : NNReal} (he : e ≠ 0) {f : ℕ} (hf : f ≠ 0) (hef : e ^ f ≠ 0)
    (m : WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)) : toNNReal hef m = toNNReal he m ^ f := by
  by_cases hm : m = 0
  · subst hm
    rw [map_zero, map_zero, zero_pow hf]
  · rw [toNNReal_neg_apply hef hm, toNNReal_neg_apply he hm, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_natCast,
      ← zpow_mul, ← zpow_mul, mul_comm]

end ToNNReal

/-! ### Places over places -/

section LiesOver

variable {F L : Type*} [Field F] [NumberField F] [Field L] [NumberField L] [Algebra F L]

/-- The finite place `w` of `L` lies over the finite place `u` of `F`:
`𝔭_w ∩ 𝓞 F = 𝔭_u`. -/
abbrev PlaceLiesOver (w : FinitePlace L) (u : FinitePlace F) : Prop :=
  w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal.LiesOver u.maximalIdeal.asIdeal

/-- The ramification index `e(w|u)`. -/
noncomputable abbrev placeRamIdx (w : FinitePlace L) (u : FinitePlace F) : ℕ :=
  u.maximalIdeal.asIdeal.ramificationIdx' w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal

/-- The inertia degree `f(w|u)`. -/
noncomputable abbrev placeInertiaDeg (w : FinitePlace L) (u : FinitePlace F) : ℕ :=
  u.maximalIdeal.asIdeal.inertiaDeg' w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal

lemma placeRamIdx_ne_zero {w : FinitePlace L} {u : FinitePlace F} (h : PlaceLiesOver w u) :
    placeRamIdx w u ≠ 0 :=
  Ideal.IsDedekindDomain.ramificationIdx'_ne_zero_of_liesOver _ u.maximalIdeal.ne_bot

lemma placeInertiaDeg_ne_zero {w : FinitePlace L} {u : FinitePlace F} (h : PlaceLiesOver w u) :
    placeInertiaDeg w u ≠ 0 := by
  haveI := u.maximalIdeal.isMaximal
  exact (Ideal.inertiaDeg'_pos _ _).ne'

/-- **`N(w) = N(u)^f`** for `w` over `u`. -/
theorem placeNorm_eq_pow {w : FinitePlace L} {u : FinitePlace F} (h : PlaceLiesOver w u) :
    placeNorm w = placeNorm u ^ placeInertiaDeg w u :=
  Ideal.absNorm_eq_pow_inertiaDeg'_of_liesOver _ _ inferInstance u.maximalIdeal.ne_bot

/-- **`w (a) = u (a)^{e·f}`** for `a ∈ F` and `w` over `u`. -/
theorem apply_algebraMap_eq_pow {w : FinitePlace L} {u : FinitePlace F} (h : PlaceLiesOver w u)
    (a : F) : w (algebraMap F L a) = u a ^ (placeRamIdx w u * placeInertiaDeg w u) := by
  rw [finitePlace_apply_eq, finitePlace_apply_eq,
    ← HeightOneSpectrum.valuation_liesOver L u.maximalIdeal w.maximalIdeal, map_pow]
  have hN : (Ideal.absNorm w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal : NNReal) =
      (Ideal.absNorm u.maximalIdeal.asIdeal : NNReal) ^ placeInertiaDeg w u := by
    exact_mod_cast placeNorm_eq_pow h
  rw [toNNReal_congr hN _ (pow_ne_zero _ (HeightOneSpectrum.absNorm_ne_zero _)),
    toNNReal_pow_base (HeightOneSpectrum.absNorm_ne_zero _) (placeInertiaDeg_ne_zero h),
    ← pow_mul, NNReal.coe_pow, mul_comm]

/-- `u (a) = 1 → w (a) = 1`, and more generally `1 < u a ↔ 1 < w a`. -/
lemma one_lt_apply_algebraMap_iff {w : FinitePlace L} {u : FinitePlace F}
    (h : PlaceLiesOver w u) (a : F) : 1 < w (algebraMap F L a) ↔ 1 < u a := by
  rw [apply_algebraMap_eq_pow h]
  exact one_lt_pow_iff_of_nonneg (apply_nonneg u a)
    (mul_ne_zero (placeRamIdx_ne_zero h) (placeInertiaDeg_ne_zero h))

/-! #### The place below -/

variable (L) in
/-- The finite place of `F` below a finite place of `L`. -/
noncomputable def placeBelow (w : FinitePlace L) : FinitePlace F :=
  FinitePlace.mk (primeBelow L w.maximalIdeal)

lemma placeBelow_maximalIdeal (w : FinitePlace L) :
    (placeBelow L w : FinitePlace F).maximalIdeal = primeBelow L w.maximalIdeal :=
  FinitePlace.maximalIdeal_mk _

/-- **The place below is unique**: if `w` lies over `u`, then `u` is the place below `w`. -/
theorem eq_placeBelow {w : FinitePlace L} {u : FinitePlace F} (h : PlaceLiesOver w u) :
    u = placeBelow L w := by
  rw [← FinitePlace.maximalIdeal_inj]
  apply HeightOneSpectrum.ext
  rw [placeBelow_maximalIdeal]
  exact h.over

lemma mem_primesOverFinset_of_placeLiesOver {w : FinitePlace L} {u : FinitePlace F}
    (h : PlaceLiesOver w u) :
    w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal ∈ IsDedekindDomain.primesOverFinset u.maximalIdeal.asIdeal (𝓞 L) := by
  haveI := u.maximalIdeal.isMaximal
  exact (mem_primesOverFinset_iff' u.maximalIdeal.ne_bot).mpr ⟨w.maximalIdeal.isPrime, h⟩

variable (L) in
/-- The finitely many places of `L` over `u`. -/
lemma finite_placeLiesOver (u : FinitePlace F) :
    {w : FinitePlace L | PlaceLiesOver w u}.Finite := by
  refine Set.Finite.of_finite_image ?_
    (f := fun w : FinitePlace L => w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal) ?_
  · refine (IsDedekindDomain.primesOverFinset u.maximalIdeal.asIdeal
      (𝓞 L)).finite_toSet.subset ?_
    rintro _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    exact mem_primesOverFinset_of_placeLiesOver hw
  · intro w₁ _ w₂ _ h
    exact (FinitePlace.maximalIdeal_inj _ _).mp (HeightOneSpectrum.ext h)

variable (L) in
/-- The finite set of places of `L` over `u`. -/
noncomputable def placesOver (u : FinitePlace F) : Finset (FinitePlace L) :=
  (finite_placeLiesOver L u).toFinset

lemma mem_placesOver {u : FinitePlace F} {w : FinitePlace L} :
    w ∈ placesOver L u ↔ PlaceLiesOver w u := by
  rw [placesOver, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Set.mem_setOf_eq]

end LiesOver

end AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ConductorExtensionSource

# Mochizuki original-paper context for the different/conductor route

Author: Shinichi Mochizuki. Title: *Arithmetic Elliptic Curves in General Position*. PDF title-page date: **February 2009**.

Official PDF: https://www.kurims.kyoto-u.ac.jp/~motizuki/Arithmetic%20Elliptic%20Curves%20in%20General%20Position.pdf

Local PDF: `/home/admin-wsl/Coq/abc/refer/Mochizuki/Arithmetic Elliptic Curves in General Position.pdf`

SHA-256: `b9dc115af61dca7fe434332ebafddf6a376a9e2926dad4e1ea2dcc0d2441f768`

HTTP HEAD 200; application/pdf; Content-Length 262332; 2026-11-14. Existing local PDF used; not downloaded.

Printed page numbers coincide with 1-based PDF page numbers.

Ghostscript txtwrite, followed by visual checking of the rasterized PDF pages. Line wrapping and typographic ligatures normalized; mathematical typography transcribed as LaTeX. Words and mathematical relation signs preserved.

**Version warning:** The existing Markdown transcription is not this PDF version: it says March 2008, while the actual PDF title page says February 2009; its Theorem 2.1 proof also differs. Do not use it as an exact-quotation source.

## Mochizuki-GenEll-Prop1.7i

Proposition 1.7(i), statement; printed/PDF pages: [9, 10].

(i) If we restrict functions on $Z(\overline{\mathbb{Q}})$, $U_Z(\overline{\mathbb{Q}})$ to $U_Y(\overline{\mathbb{Q}})$ via $\phi$, then
\[
\mathrm{log\text{-}cond}_E-\mathrm{log\text{-}cond}_D\lesssim\mathrm{log\text{-}diff}_Y-\mathrm{log\text{-}diff}_Z\lesssim\left(1-\frac{1}{e}\right)\cdot\mathrm{log\text{-}cond}_E
\]
on $U_Y(\overline{\mathbb{Q}})$.

Context (not quotation): Here φ:Y→Z is a generically finite morphism of normal Z-proper Z-flat dimension-two schemes; D and E are effective Z-flat Cartier divisors with reduced generic fibers, D_Q=φ_Q^{-1}(E_Q)_red, finite étale restriction off the divisors, and ramification indices along D_Q dividing e. The statement uses BD-class comparisons (≲), not an exact numerical finite-set inequality.

## Mochizuki-GenEll-Prop1.7-localClaim

Proposition 1.7(i), proof, indented elementary claim; printed/PDF pages: [10].

Fix a prime number $p$ and a positive integer $d$. Then there exists a positive integer $n$ such that for any finite Galois extension $L/K$ of finite extensions of $\mathbb{Q}_p$ with $[L:K]\leq d$, the different ideal of $L/K$ contains $p^n\cdot\mathcal{O}_L$ [where we write $\mathcal{O}_L$ for the ring of integers of $L$].

Context (not quotation): The preceding proof paragraph reduces boundedness of the portion over a finite set Σ of log-diff_Y−log-diff_Z to this elementary local claim. This is supporting background, not the exact new finite-set conductor-extension child.

## Mochizuki-GenEll-Thm2.1-BelyiDescent

Theorem 2.1, proof, first paragraph on printed page 13 (selected complete sentences); printed/PDF pages: [13].

On the other hand, by choosing appropriate normal, $\mathbb{Z}$-proper, $\mathbb{Z}$-flat models for $P$, $X$, we may apply Proposition 1.7, (i) [where we take “$e$” to be 1], to conclude that $\mathrm{log\text{-}diff}_P+\mathrm{log\text{-}cond}_C\lesssim\mathrm{log\text{-}diff}_X+\mathrm{log\text{-}cond}_E$ on $\Xi$. Also, we recall from Proposition 1.6 that $\mathrm{log\text{-}cond}_E\lesssim\mathrm{ht}_E\stackrel{\mathrm{def}}{=}\mathrm{ht}_{\mathcal{O}_X(E)}$ on $\Xi$. Thus, by Proposition 1.4, (i), (iii), we compute to find that

Context (not quotation): On printed page 12, φ:X→P is the noncritical Belyi map unramified over U_P, C={0,1,∞}, and E=φ^{-1}(C)_red. The paragraph continues with the displayed height calculation. The first complete quoted sentence is sufficient for the different/conductor comparison route; the additional sentences show its immediate height consumer.

def BelyiActualFieldLocalConductorComparison : Prop :=
  ∀ {N : ℕ} (M : Model N) (hRF : ResiduesFinite M) (φ : M.K)
    (x : QbarPoint M.K) (hgood : GoodValue M x φ),
    letI : FiniteDimensional ℚ x.fieldOf := pointField_finiteDimensional M hRF x
    letI : Algebra (Tripod.fieldOf (belyiImage M φ x).1) x.fieldOf :=
      (IntermediateField.inclusion (belyiImage_field_le M φ x hgood)).toRingHom.toAlgebra
    ∀ u : FinitePlace (Tripod.fieldOf (belyiImage M φ x).1),
      Real.log (placeNorm u) / finrank ℚ (Tripod.fieldOf (belyiImage M φ x).1) ≤

          diffContrib x.fieldOf u.maximalIdeal.asIdeal

  ∀ {N : ℕ} (M : Model N) (hRF : ResiduesFinite M) (φ : M.K)
    (x : QbarPoint M.K) (hgood : GoodValue M x φ),
    letI : FiniteDimensional ℚ x.fieldOf := pointField_finiteDimensional M hRF x
    letI : Algebra (Tripod.fieldOf (belyiImage M φ x).1) x.fieldOf :=
      (IntermediateField.inclusion (belyiImage_field_le M φ x hgood)).toRingHom.toAlgebra
    (Function.support fun 𝔭 : HeightOneSpectrum
      (𝓞 (Tripod.fieldOf (belyiImage M φ x).1)) =>
        diffContrib x.fieldOf 𝔭.asIdeal).Finite ∧
    Real.log (Ideal.absNorm
      (differentIdeal (𝓞 (Tripod.fieldOf (belyiImage M φ x).1)) (𝓞 x.fieldOf))) /
        finrank ℚ x.fieldOf =
      ∑ᶠ 𝔭 : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 (Tripod.fieldOf (belyiImage M φ x).1)),

end AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper

import Definitions.Def_FermatBelyiConductorExtensionFinitePlaces

set_option autoImplicit false
open NumberField IsDedekindDomain Module
open scoped Classical IntermediateField

namespace AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper

open ConductorExtensionSource

/-- Exact source Conductor.lean:104, restricted to the actual inclusion φ(x)-field ⊆ x-field.
The left term is normalized by the image-field degree; all right terms by the full point-field
 degree. No field, algebra, height, or correction term is supplied by a model law. -/
def BelyiActualFieldLocalConductorComparison : Prop :=
  ∀ {N : ℕ} (M : Model N) (hRF : ResiduesFinite M) (φ : M.K)
    (x : QbarPoint M.K) (hgood : GoodValue M x φ),
    letI : FiniteDimensional ℚ x.fieldOf := pointField_finiteDimensional M hRF x
    letI : Algebra (Tripod.fieldOf (belyiImage M φ x).1) x.fieldOf :=
      (IntermediateField.inclusion (belyiImage_field_le M φ x hgood)).toRingHom.toAlgebra
    ∀ u : FinitePlace (Tripod.fieldOf (belyiImage M φ x).1),
      Real.log (placeNorm u) / finrank ℚ (Tripod.fieldOf (belyiImage M φ x).1) ≤
        (∑ w ∈ placesOver x.fieldOf u, Real.log (placeNorm w) / finrank ℚ x.fieldOf) +
          diffContrib x.fieldOf u.maximalIdeal.asIdeal

/-- Exact source NumberField.lean:228/256, for the same actual inclusion.
The support finiteness is explicit: `finsum` alone does not justify a finite-subsum bound.
This child has no conductor inequality or finite element sets hidden in its statement. -/
def BelyiActualFieldDifferentAccounting : Prop :=
  ∀ {N : ℕ} (M : Model N) (hRF : ResiduesFinite M) (φ : M.K)
    (x : QbarPoint M.K) (hgood : GoodValue M x φ),
    letI : FiniteDimensional ℚ x.fieldOf := pointField_finiteDimensional M hRF x
    letI : Algebra (Tripod.fieldOf (belyiImage M φ x).1) x.fieldOf :=
      (IntermediateField.inclusion (belyiImage_field_le M φ x hgood)).toRingHom.toAlgebra
    (Function.support fun 𝔭 : HeightOneSpectrum
      (𝓞 (Tripod.fieldOf (belyiImage M φ x).1)) =>
        diffContrib x.fieldOf 𝔭.asIdeal).Finite ∧
    Real.log (Ideal.absNorm
      (differentIdeal (𝓞 (Tripod.fieldOf (belyiImage M φ x).1)) (𝓞 x.fieldOf))) /
        finrank ℚ x.fieldOf =
      ∑ᶠ 𝔭 : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 (Tripod.fieldOf (belyiImage M φ x).1)),
        diffContrib x.fieldOf 𝔭.asIdeal

end AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper

对每个自然数 $N$，取固定的 $\mathbb Q(t)$ 的代数闭包中介于 $\mathbb Q$ 与该闭包之间的域 $K$，并取 $u,v\in K$，满足 $u$ 在 $\mathbb Q$ 上超越、$u^N+v^N=1$、$\mathbb Q(u,v)=K$，且 $K$ 在 $\mathbb Q(u)$ 上有限维、次数为 $N$。假设 $K$ 的每个包含 $\mathbb Q$ 的真赋值子环 $O$ 的剩余域 $\kappa(O)$ 都在 $\mathbb Q$ 上有限维。对每个由这种 $O$ 与环同态 $\sigma:\kappa(O)\to\overline{\mathbb Q}$ 组成的点 $x=(O,\sigma)$，以及每个在 $O$ 中正则、满足 $a=\sigma(\operatorname{res}_O\varphi)\ne0,1$ 的 $\varphi\in K$，令 $L=\sigma(\kappa(O))$、$F=\mathbb Q(a)\subseteq L$。$L$ 在 $\mathbb Q$ 上的有限维结构取自剩余域有限性；$L$ 的 $F$ 代数结构由这一实际包含映射诱导。记 $n_E=[E:\mathbb Q]$，$D_{L/F}=\operatorname{differentIdeal}(\mathcal O_F,\mathcal O_L)$（不同理想），并定义 $\delta_{L/F}(\mathfrak q)=\sum_{P\in\Pi_L(\mathfrak q)}\operatorname{multiplicity}_P(D_{L/F})\log|\mathcal O_L/P|/n_L$；其中 $\Pi_L(\mathfrak q)$ 是库中给定的位于理想 $\mathfrak q$ 之上的素理想有限集，重数与范数按代码映入实数。对域 $E$ 的有限处 $v$，$\mathfrak p_v$ 表示对应的非零素理想，且 $N(v)=|\mathcal O_E/\mathfrak p_v|$。对数域 $E$ 的任意有限子集 $A$，定义 $C_E(A)=(\sum^{\mathrm f}_{v\text{ 为 }E\text{ 的有限处}} b_A(v))/n_E$：当存在 $a\in A$ 使 $v(a)>1$ 时，$b_A(v)=\log|\mathcal O_E/\mathfrak p_v|$，否则为零；$\sum^{\mathrm f}$ 表示代码中的有限支撑求和。允许 $A$ 为空集。对上述每组实际模型与点的数据，以及任意有限子集 $S\subset F$、$T\subset L$，若 $S$ 在实际包含映射 $F\hookrightarrow L$ 下的像包含于 $T$，则 $C_F(S)\le C_L(T)+\log|\mathcal O_L/D_{L/F}|/n_L$。

**日本語**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.belyiActualFieldConductorExtension`

任意の自然数 $N$ に対し、固定された $\mathbb Q(t)$ の代数閉包の中間体 $\mathbb Q\subseteq K$ と $u,v\in K$ をとる。$u$ は $\mathbb Q$ 上超越的で、$u^N+v^N=1$、$\mathbb Q(u,v)=K$ であり、$K$ は $\mathbb Q(u)$ 上有限次元で次数が $N$ であるとする。$\mathbb Q$ を含む $K$ の任意の真の付値部分環 $O$ について剰余体 $\kappa(O)$ が $\mathbb Q$ 上有限次元であると仮定する。このような $O$ と環準同型 $\sigma:\kappa(O)\to\overline{\mathbb Q}$ からなる任意の点 $x=(O,\sigma)$、および $O$ で正則で $a=\sigma(\operatorname{res}_O\varphi)\ne0,1$ を満たす任意の $\varphi\in K$ に対し、$L=\sigma(\kappa(O))$、$F=\mathbb Q(a)\subseteq L$ とおく。$L/\mathbb Q$ の有限次元構造は剰余体の有限性から得たものとし、$L$ の $F$ 代数構造はこの実際の包含から誘導する。$n_E=[E:\mathbb Q]$、$D_{L/F}=\operatorname{differentIdeal}(\mathcal O_F,\mathcal O_L)$（相対デデキント異種イデアル）、$\delta_{L/F}(\mathfrak q)=\sum_{P\in\Pi_L(\mathfrak q)}\operatorname{multiplicity}_P(D_{L/F})\log|\mathcal O_L/P|/n_L$ とおく。ここで $\Pi_L(\mathfrak q)$ はイデアル $\mathfrak q$ の上にある素イデアルからなるライブラリの有限集合であり、重複度とノルムは実数に写して用いる。$E$ の有限素点 $v$ について、$\mathfrak p_v$ は対応する非零素イデアルを表し、$N(v)=|\mathcal O_E/\mathfrak p_v|$ とする。数体 $E$ の有限部分集合 $A$ について $C_E(A)=(\sum^{\mathrm f}_{v\text{ は }E\text{ の有限素点}} b_A(v))/n_E$ と定義する。ある $a\in A$ が $v(a)>1$ を満たす場合は $b_A(v)=\log|\mathcal O_E/\mathfrak p_v|$、それ以外は $b_A(v)=0$ である。$\sum^{\mathrm f}$ はコードの有限台和である。$A$ は空集合でもよい。このような実際のモデルと点のデータの任意の組、および任意の有限部分集合 $S\subset F$、$T\subset L$ について、実際の包含 $F\hookrightarrow L$ による $S$ の像が $T$ に含まれるならば、$C_F(S)\le C_L(T)+\log|\mathcal O_L/D_{L/F}|/n_L$ が成り立つ。
